title: Provenance events and hop-aggregation for SLO-aligned routing observability
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Current routing diagnostics emit very high-cardinality traces and full-span dumps for many requests. This produces high storage/ingestion cost, noisy dashboards, and slow investigator workflows when debugging region/tier routing and fallback decisions. We need a compact, structured provenance event format plus hop-aggregation to capture the essential decision telemetry while preserving the ability to reconstruct full traces for SLO failures and customer-impacting incidents.

Goal: Implement a provenance-events pipeline and hop-aggregation at the routing proxy so that: (1) normal requests emit compact per-request provenance events with summarized per-hop metrics, (2) requests that trigger SLO violations or policy fallbacks produce full trace exports, and (3) Console can display both per-request provenance and aggregated per-hop histograms by region/tier/model_variant. This will reduce telemetry costs, speed up incident analysis, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio for routing observability.

Scope: routing proxy (smart-router), streaming/ingest topics, storage schemas (analytics store + traces), Console UI surface for provenance and aggregated metrics, rollout + backfill plan. Not in scope: changing model serving runtime kernels or internal model telemetry beyond adding model_variant tags in events.
acceptance_criteria: Provenance event schema (v1) defined and documented in Confluence with examples
Routing proxy emits provenance events to new Kafka topic routing.provenance.v1 for all requests
Compact event size <= 1KB average for non-error requests (measured over 1M requests)
Full traces are exported for requests that exceed latency or error SLOs (configurable thresholds) and can be correlated with provenance events
Console shows per-hop aggregated latency histograms and a drilldown that links from aggregated rows to individual full traces or provenance events
Telemetry cost for routing observability reduced by >= 40% in staging compared to current full-trace baseline
Integration tests and e2e test harness validate provenance-to-trace correlation and sampling rules
technical_decisions: Use a compact JSON Lines provenance event format (routing.provenance.v1) instead of full OTEL spans for normal requests to reduce size and cardinality

Include fixed set of tags on provenance events: request_id, timestamp, region, tier, model_variant, fallback_reason (optional), route_id, outcome, token_count, latency_ms_total, hop_summaries (array of small hop objects)
Hop summaries include: hop_index, component (router|proxy|model), region, tier, latency_ms, decision (allowed|redirect|fallback), sampled_trace_id (optional)

Adaptive sampling: emit sampled_trace_id and trigger full OTEL trace export when (a) request latency > configured SLO or (b) fallback_reason != null or (c) random sample rate e.g., 0.1% for synthetic coverage

Implement a lightweight hop-aggregation microservice that consumes routing.provenance.v1, computes per-region/tier hop histograms and top fallback reasons, and writes metrics to ClickHouse and Prometheus summaries
Store provenance events for 30 days in the analytics store; full OTEL traces retained for 90 days for incidents per compliance policy
Correlation: sampled_trace_id is the key linking provenance events with full trace spans and SDK logs. Console will use this id for fast navigation
Backward compatibility: add a migration layer in the consumer to accept older fields and map to v1 schema for dashboards during rollout
rollout_plan: Week 1: Schema finalization and Confluence design doc (ENG + PM review)
Week 2: Implement emission in smart-router with feature flag off; unit tests and internal consumer stub
Week 3: Deploy consumer in staging, run ingestion and verify hop-aggregation outputs; enable adaptive sampling in staging at conservative thresholds
Week 4: UAT with on-call and SRE, verify Console drilldowns and correlation links; measure event size and ingestion cost
Week 5: Gradual rollout to production with 10% traffic, ramp to 100% over 3 days if metrics stable
Post-rollout: Run a 7-day backfill for critical dashboards using historical traces for parity checks
migration_steps: Create new Kafka topic routing.provenance.v1 and grant consumer ACLs to hop-aggregation service
Deploy smart-router change behind feature flag that emits provenance.v1 with sample_rate=0 initially
Start consumer in read-only mode to validate schema and write to a staging ClickHouse table
Enable adaptive sampling rules in staging and validate full-trace linkage using sampled_trace_id
Switch feature flag to sample_rate=100% in staging to measure size and costs, then adjust to production target
Coordinate with Console team to add UI components that read aggregated metrics and provenance events (feature-flagged)
After production rollout, run backfill ETL to populate aggregated historical metrics for the last 30 days
testing_plan: Unit tests for provenance event serialization/deserialization (edge cases: missing fields, unknown region)
Integration tests that simulate multi-hop requests and assert hop_aggregation histograms are correct
E2E test which injects SLO-violating requests and verifies full traces are emitted and linked
Load test (1M requests) in staging to measure average event size and Kafka throughput
Chaos test to validate behavior when consumer lag grows or Kafka partitions are reassigned
Security review to validate PII-free fields and KMS rules for any sensitive traces
